title: Meihanda Xtreme Phantom P10
notes: The manufacturer homepage names Meihanda Xtreme Phantom P10, specifies a 7005 aluminum frame, T800 carbon fork and hydraulic disc brakes, and presents an exact Shimano U6000 10-speed flat-bar P10 product. The manufacturer describes the Phantom series as accepting tires up to 40C. Conflicting foreign-site price cards are not used as China-market price evidence, and the series-level clearance statement retains its missing rim-width and measured-width conditions.
